text:
emily.k: hi folks, emily here, first week on infra team. Trying to pull some EU S3 logs from the central account but I can't assume the cross-account role. Getting `AccessDenied` on `aws sts assume-role`. What exact AWS roles/policy do i need and who can link my user to the EU billing account if required?
rishab: welcome! For cross-account fetch you need an IAM principal that can assume the target role. Usually we create a role in the EU account with trust for `arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-devs-assumer` (or let you assume `redwood-engineering-ci`). On your side you need permission `sts:AssumeRole` + `iam:PassRole` only if you're passing a role to a service. Did you try the assume command with the right role arn?
emily.k: i ran `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rdw-readonly-eu --role-session-name emily-test` and got `An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User: arn:aws:iam::999888777666:user/emily.k is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rdw-readonly-eu`
kevin.m: finance note: linking to billing doesn't grant IAM perms. If you need to run resources that incur costs we need project ID + cost center. For AWS we link the account (111222333444) to the EU billing consolidated payer; provide a short justification. For onboarding tests we set a $150/mo soft limit.
devops: quick options: 1) we can create a short-lived *assume role* in the EU account that trusts your SSO identity (preferred), 2) add your user to the org-level group `cloud-readers` which has `sts:AssumeRole` for read roles, or 3) we can run the export for you if you only need S3 objects. Which do you want?
emily.k: ideally I want to run queries myself (speed). If option 1 is easiest, can someone create the role with minimal perms to list/read S3 and allow my user to assume for 8 hours? Also curious about region permissions: any restrictions for eu-west-1 vs eu-central-1?
rishab: created a role template: policy: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-eu-logs","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-eu-logs/*"]}]}` trust policy trusts `arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-onboard-assumer` (SSO mapping). We'll also add condition `aws:RequestedRegion` if you want to limit to eu-west-1.
kevin.m: billing linked once we have account-id + cost center. Please note: to rotate keys or change billing owners you need the billing-admin role and 2FA.
ops-billing-bot: Billing update: request received for account 111222333444. Link pending approval from finance. Budget alerts will be set at 80% threshold.
emily.k: thanks! rishab, can you make a role `rdw-onboard-emily` with 8h session and trust my SSO principal? If you post the assume-role arn i can try again.
rishab: done — role `arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rdw-onboard-emily` created, policy scoped to `redwood-eu-logs` and session duration 8h. Try: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rdw-onboard-emily --role-session-name emily-test --duration-seconds 28800`.
emily.k: success! `Credentials` returned and i can list objects. Thanks. One more: any quota issues for cross-account S3 GETs or VPC endpoints?
devops: S3 cross-account GETs are normal; watch rate limits if you do thousands of GETs/sec. If you need high throughput set up a VPC endpoint in your VPC and request a quota bump for `accelerated-transfers` if using transfer acceleration. For compute in eu regions, GPU quotas are separate per account.
emily.k: noted. kevin, i'll send cost justification to link the account — expected cost < $120/mo for this eval.
kevin.m: got it, linking now. You'll get a notification when billing link completes.
emily.k: perfect, thanks everyone for the fast assist :tada:
